2120092052931133554.en_summary: Gary Black reports US stocks paused (SPX +0.2%, NDX flat) ahead of inflation data, NVDA case developments and Anthropic IPO kickoff. Brent crude fell 3% to $90/bbl (down 24% in 10 days on Trump’s more conciliatory Iran tone). The 10yr treasury yield rose +0.2bp to 4.88%, with markets pricing over 80% odds of a Fed hike next month. Tech mixed: $NVDA +1.6% to $178; $MU, $MRVL, $AVGO up slightly; $TSLA -0.5% and $SPCX -0.4%. S&P 2026 EPS estimates ($369 +33% YoY, P/E 20x) showed no degradation after Dem midterm victories. He remains cautious on $TSLA due to extended valuation (2026 P/E 218x, PEG 4.8x), negative forward earnings revisions, and continued commoditization of autonomy.
2120092052931133554.zh_summary: Gary Black 報告美股暫停上漲（標普500指數+0.2%，納斯達克100指數持平），等待通脹數據、NVDA案件發展及Anthropic IPO啟動。布倫特原油下跌3%至90美元/桶（10日內下跌24%，因特朗普對伊朗語氣較為溫和）。10年期國債收益率微升0.2個基點至4.88%，市場定價下月聯儲局加息概率超過80%。科技股表現不一：$NVDA上漲1.6%至178美元；$MU、$MRVL、$AVGO小幅上漲；$TSLA下跌0.5%，$SPCX下跌0.4%。標普2026年每股盈利估算（369美元，同比+33%，市盈率20倍）在民主黨中期選舉大勝後未見下調。他仍對$TSLA保持謹慎，因其估值偏高（2026年市盈率218倍，PEG 4.8倍）、前瞻盈利下修，以及自動駕駛商品化持續。

ticker_notes.TSLA: extended valuation 2026 P/E 218x PEG 4.8x, negative revisions, autonomy commoditization

2120074819878449605.en_summary: Serenity analyzes CW laser ASPs for AI data centers, with 70mW at ~$3-4, 100mW at ~$4-6, and higher prices for NPO/CPO types up to $50-75, noting margins rise with architectural shifts (60%+ for CPO). Views $COHR as best risk-adjusted laser player with substantial new $20B LTA. Sees $LITE as pretty negative due to valuation overhang from $MRVL acquisition despite positive operations. $AAOI has extreme demand visibility (likely $6-9B new LTAs) but execution uncertainty; potential catalyst from late-stage $5-7B LTA discussion given $4.4B market cap. $SIVE has extreme capacity expansion but qualification uncertainty that markets have punished. Notes entire AI trade moving together.
2120074819878449605.zh_summary: Serenity 分析人工智能數據中心連續波激光器平均售價，70mW約3-4美元、100mW約4-6美元，NPO/CPO類型更高達50-75美元，並指出利潤率隨架構轉變上升（CPO激光器超過60%）。認為$COHR是風險調整後最佳激光器玩家，擁有實質性新的200億美元長期協議。認為$LITE因$MRVL收購估值壓力而相當負面，儘管營運正面。$AAOI需求可見度極高（可能60-90億美元新長期協議）但執行存在不確定性；考慮到44億美元市值，若後期階段50-70億美元協議討論或成催化劑。$SIVE產能大幅擴張但資格認證不確定性已遭市場懲罰。指出目前整個人工智能交易板塊同步波動。

ticker_notes.COHR: best risk adjusted with new $20B LTA
ticker_notes.AAOI: strong demand visibility but execution uncertainty, potential LTA catalyst
